source.title: hasKey() throws on objects created with Object.create(null)

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
## 现象

`hasKey()` in `packages/workflow/src/utils.ts` calls `value.hasOwnProperty(key)` directly:

```ts
export function hasKey<T extends PropertyKey>(value: unknown, key: T): value is Record<T, unknown> {
	return value !== null && typeof value === 'object' && value.hasOwnProperty(key);
}
```

When `value` is an object without a prototype (created via `Object.create(null)`), `hasOwnProperty` is not inherited, so the function throws `TypeError: value.hasOwnProperty is not a function` instead of returning a boolean.

## 最小复现

```ts
import { hasKey } from 'n8n-workflow';

const record = Object.create(null);
record.key = 'value';

hasKey(record, 'key');     // throws TypeError: value.hasOwnProperty is not a function
hasKey(record, 'missing'); // throws instead of returning false
```

Prototype-less records are produced inside the repo itself (e.g. `nullProtoRecord()` in `packages/workflow/src/connections-diff.ts`) and are a common way to hold key-controlled data.

## 期望

`hasKey` should use `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key)` and return `true`/`false` for prototype-less objects, consistent with its behaviour for ordinary objects, arrays and primitives.

## 影响

Any code path that feeds a prototype-less record into `hasKey` (for example error/metadata parsing built on `hasKey`) crashes with a `TypeError` instead of performing a simple key lookup. This turns an ordinary key check into an execution failure whenever the input object has no prototype.

comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The current implementation calls `value.hasOwnProperty(key)` directly, which fails both for null-prototype objects and for objects that shadow that method. `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(value, key)` avoids both cases while preserving the existing object-only guard. A focused regression can cover a null-prototype record with the key present and missing; a shadowed `hasOwnProperty` case would verify the call is independent of the input method.
